O.outcome_detail: listening comprehension test score for text 3

cells.quote: However, a statistically significant difference was found between the groups for text 3 (t = -2.6986, df = 55, p < 0.05), where the average score of the AOT group was higher by nearly a full point.
cells.note: AOT participants scored higher than VOT participants.
